data.one_liner: Appium binding for Dart supporting WebDriver W3C spec to write UI tests.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Appium client for writing UI tests in Dart, including interactions outside Flutter views. It supports the W3C protocol, session discovery, and device/application control commands.
use_when: You need to write UI integration tests for mobile apps using Appium in Dart
You require interactions outside of Flutter views during tests
avoid_when: You are using the legacy JSONWire protocol (unsupported)
You only need standard widget tests or integration tests via flutter_test
strengths: Full W3C protocol support inheriting from webdriver.dart
Comprehensive coverage of Appium device, application, and file commands
weaknesses: Requires a running Appium server and a configured device or emulator
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.4 or later, a running Appium server, and a configured device or emulator.
